reason: The prior record correctly, honestly documented that a `let (a, b) = ..;` (or any tuple/tuple-struct/struct/slice/reference/paren/@-binding/Or) destructuring pattern bound no Definitions -- a stated gap, not a fabricated capability.

R4.12's gap audit against the R4 acceptance contract's reference-profile requirement surfaced this as a real, closeable Rust-construct gap rather than leaving it open indefinitely: destructuring bindings are common, syntactically unambiguous (Rust's pattern grammar needs no type inference to know which identifiers a pattern binds), and closing it required no new identity model -- ValueIdentity/DataFlowResolution were already sufficient.

fix.what: adapter::semantic::rust::dataflow::DataFlowWalker::walk_binding_pat replaces the old simple_pat_ident (Pat::Ident/Pat::Type only) helper at every binding-position call site (let, match-arm, for-loop pattern, function/closure parameter): it recurses through Pat::Tuple/TupleStruct/Struct/Slice/Reference/Paren, and Pat::Ident's own @ sub-pattern, emitting a Definition for every simple identifier binding found. Pat::Or walks every alternative (each may bind the same name at its own span, since only one alternative matches at runtime and this walker does not attempt to prove which). Pat::Wild/Rest/Lit/Range/Path/Const/Macro/Verbatim and any future non_exhaustive variant bind nothing, matched explicitly or via an intentional catch-all.
adversarial_coverage_added: tuple_destructuring_pattern_binds_both_sub_bindings_and_their_uses_resolve (rewritten from the prior gap-proving test to now prove the fix)

new_interpretation: R4.7's destructuring-pattern gap is CLOSED. R4.7 bootstrap remains materialized; R4.7's own overall closure status (shared CALL macro-invocation-opacity gap; CALL<->DATA_FLOW argument/result binding still a separate open TARGET) is otherwise unchanged by this correction.
required_runtime_invariants: every simple identifier binding inside a tuple/tuple-struct/struct/slice/reference/paren/@ pattern in a let/match-arm/for/parameter position emits a Definition
an Or pattern's shared bound name gets one Definition per alternative, never a single fabricated merged one
a pattern shape that binds nothing (wildcard, rest, literal, range, path, const) still emits no Definition
